scope: Read-only final-review preparation using saved documentation, delivered BOM workbook/CSV, root connectivity report and exported with-protection.net. No live session or KiCad source read. Final PCB, CPL, Gerbers, ERC/DRC and manufacturing reconciliation are outside this phase.
conclusion: No new concrete documentation, channel-map, connector-pin or BOM-selection blocker found. The documents accurately describe pending fabrication checks and hardware acceptance; they do not claim completed production qualification.

verified: No duplicate designators or quantity-to-designator-count mismatch.
SMT CSV rows equal the workbook's JLCPCB SMT only tab. Its designator set exactly equals the main sheet's SMT set.
All fitted BOM designators are present in the exported netlist; omitted netlist items are exactly holes, test points and solder jumpers.

scope: Pump1 LED0 through R35/Q3 to U8; pump2 LED1 through R42/Q4 to U11.
Valve1 P0 through R55/Q10 to U10; valve2 P1 through R36/Q8 to U9.
SW1/SW2 map to P4/P5; SW3/SW4 to P6/P7; switch common sides are grounded.
J18 pins1/2/3 are GND/SDA/SCL. J1,J3,J9,J12,J17 pins1/2/3/4 are GND/3V3/SDA/SCL.
SDA/SCL pull-ups are 4.7k to local3V3. TCA9534A address pins pull high for0x3F; PCA9685 address pins pull low for0x40 with jumpers open.
Load pin1 is its positive rail; pin2 is the low-side switched return.
All original pin-group connectivity is preserved excluding the intended D1 output split. Root's supplied connectivity comparison is independently corroborated.

primary_reference_checks.result: Documented register sequence is appropriate: clear output latch before enabling P0/P1 outputs, configuration0xFC. Output latches reset HIGH while directions reset to inputs.

All Call0x70 is enabled after reset; default Sub1 address0x71 is disabled. Keeping Sub Call disabled avoids collision with mux0x71. Documented 500us oscillator stabilization and shared PWM frequency are correct.
One-hot channel selection followed by STOP, upstream pull-ups and hardware RESET recovery are correctly described.
EHR-3 housing and SEH-001T-P0.6 contacts belong to the selected EH family. Wire/crimp and end-to-end pin verification are appropriately required.

Current product text names a6V valve with an XH-compatible2.5mm cable. Some image alt text still says PH; document's requirement to verify actual connector fit/polarity remains appropriate. No proven header mismatch.

known_open_items_already_documented: Exact SMBJ13A identity must be checked despite contradictory distributor attributes. This is visible in the BOM and notes, not silently accepted.
12V2A is an initial single-board supply selection, not a verified simultaneous-start capability or total system supply budget.
Intermittent pumps and keep-last commands are explicit accepted operating choices; no new watchdog requirement is introduced.
Bench acceptance, controller firmware implementation, cable polarity, actual pump mounting and final fabrication/CPL reconciliation remain open.
